scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply saldo --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.format: prettier --write src server bridge tests docs README.md
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:bridge
scripts.cf:build:app: npm run build && cd deployment && cf build --mode app
scripts.cf:build:bridge: npm run check:bridge && cd deployment && cf build --mode bridge
scripts.cf:check:app: npm run cf:build:app && cd deployment && cf deploy --dry-run --prebuilt --mode app
scripts.cf:check:bridge: npm run cf:build:bridge && cd deployment && cf deploy --dry-run --prebuilt --mode bridge --containers-rollout none
